enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Adjust fan speed. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn head. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Kettle boils. Pour water into mug. Remove toast. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Rinse dishes. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone for the day's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work bag. Open work bag. Pick up laptop. Place laptop in bag. Pick up charger. Place charger in bag. Pick up notebook. Place notebook in bag. Zip work bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open email app. Check program schedule. Close email app. Place phone in pocket. Pick up work bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check bus schedule on phone. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Open door. Enter lobby. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, emails and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to email from partner. Open program logistics spreadsheet. Update volunteer list. Make phone call to partner. Say 'Hello, this is Member 1.' Discuss event details. Hang up. Open document. Write program plan. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up document. Walk back to desk. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send meeting invite.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nearby cafe. Open door. Walk to counter. Read menu. Order sandwich. Pay with card. Take receipt. Wait for order. Pick up sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw napkin in trash. Stand up. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work: planning upcoming community events, meeting volunteers and updating program records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open event planning software. Create new event. Enter event details. Set date and time. Add location. Call volunteer coordinator. Discuss volunteer list. Hang up. Update volunteer list in database. Open program records. Review attendance data. Enter new data. Save file. Walk to meeting room. Meet volunteers. Discuss event logistics. Assign tasks. Walk back to desk. Send follow-up email.

Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap to sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Wash mug. Rinse mug. Place mug in dish rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in dish rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Wipe sink. Throw away trash. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, reading and setting an alarm on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open clock app. Set alarm for 6:30. Close app. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn off fan.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust fan speed. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn head. Remain still.
